messages:
olivia-peopleops: quick one — Ben has approval for a band bump for Nina effective 2026-09-01. Ben asked if we should retro to 9/1 or make comp effective 9/15.
ben-engmgr: want to match offers we send next week so prefer retro. What do we need and any gotchas?
nina-ic: also curious if retro pay affects my bonus accrual or any probation check-ins.
olivia-peopleops: retro is fine if paperwork + payroll hit cutoff. For mid-month retro to land on 2026-09-15 run, approvals + completed Workday comp change flagged "retro" must be in and approved by the payroll cutoff (usually the 10th). If missed, it'll process on 2026-10-15 and backpay will cover 9/1-9/14.
br-engmgr: approvals I have manager+director. Anything else?
olivia-peopleops: Attach manager approval email, calibration excerpt/rubric, completed comp-change form in Workday with note "retro pay requested 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-14", and email hr-escalations CC payroll. PDFs only.
hr-ops-bot: payroll note: cutoff for 2026-09-15 run = 2026-09-10 23:59 PT. International employees may need extra lead time. Cross-cost-center moves require both managers' approval and will delay processing if missing.
nina-ic: bonus/vesting?
olivia-peopleops: Bonus target updates when comp posts; vesting does not reset unless a new grant is issued. Managers should schedule 30/60 check-ins for role transition.
ben-engmgr: last: sample note to paste into Workday?
olivia-peopleops: paste: "Approved level change L3->L4 effective 2026-09-01. Retro pay requested for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-14. Attached: manager approval and calibration note. Payroll: please attempt processing in 2026-09-15 run (cutoff 2026-09-10); if not possible, process on 2026-10-15 and notify manager"
ben-engmgr: perfect, filing today :thumbsup:
hr-ops-bot: Reminder: attach PDFs. Non-PDFs delay processing.
